description: Flat metadata schema for individual urban air sample records used for metagenomic sequencing and environmental association analysis.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual air-sample record.

project_id.descr: Project or study identifier linking the sample to the broader investigation.

site_name.descr: Name of the sampling location/site (e.g., park, street intersection, rooftop station).

site_type.descr: Categorical description of the urban environment sampled; examples: street canyon, rooftop, residential area, industrial area, park, transit hub.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

city.descr: City or metropolitan area where the sample was collected.

address_or_location_description.descr: Free-text location description sufficient to interpret the sampling site.

sampling_height_m.descr: Height of the sampler inlet above ground level in meters.

height_reference.descr: Reference for height measurement; examples: ground level, rooftop level, street level.

collection_time_local.descr: Local time when sampling began or was recorded (HH:MM:SS).

time_zone.descr: Time zone of the collection time; examples: UTC+1, Europe/Berlin.

day_period.descr: Broad time-of-day category; examples: morning, afternoon, evening, night.

sampling_duration_min.descr: Total active sampling duration in minutes.

air_volume_m3.descr: Total volume of air sampled, in cubic meters.

sampling_device.descr: Sampler/instrument used; include model if available.

flow_rate_l_min.descr: Average sampler flow rate in liters per minute.

filter_or_capture_medium.descr: Filter, impinger, or other capture medium used to collect particulate/airborne biomass.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Nominal pore size of the filter in micrometers, if applicable.

sample_preservation_method.descr: How the collected sample was preserved prior to extraction; examples: frozen, RNAlater, dry ice, ambient transport.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius before nucleic acid extraction.

temperature_c.descr: Ambient air temperature at the time of sampling in degrees Celsius.

relative_humidity_percent.descr: Relative humidity at sampling time as percent (0-100).

particulate_matter_pm2_5_ug_m3.descr: PM2.5 concentration at sampling time in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m3).

particulate_matter_pm10_ug_m3.descr: PM10 concentration at sampling time in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m3).

weather_condition.descr: Weather description during sampling; examples: clear, cloudy, rainy, foggy, snowy, windy.

precipitation_mm.descr: Precipitation during the sampling interval in millimeters, if measured.

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed at sampling time in meters per second, if measured.

wind_direction_deg.descr: Wind direction in degrees from north (0-360), if measured.

solar_radiation_w_m2.descr: Solar radiation at sampling time in watts per square meter, if measured.

traffic_intensity.descr: Qualitative or quantitative measure of local traffic/human activity near the sampling site; examples: low, moderate, high, vehicle count per hour.

human_activity_context.descr: Description of nearby human activity likely affecting airborne microbiota; examples: commuting, market activity, construction, recreational use.

urban_land_use.descr: Dominant land-use class around the sampling site; examples: residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, green space.

sample_matrix.descr: Sample matrix type; for this study typically air, but may include specific fractions such as PM2.5 filter eluate.

nucleic_acid_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid extracted for sequencing; examples: DNA, RNA, total nucleic acid.

extraction_kit.descr: Commercial kit or extraction method used to isolate nucleic acids.

extraction_protocol_id.descr: Identifier or version of the extraction protocol used.

extraction_date.descr: Date nucleic acid extraction was performed (YYYY-MM-DD).

extraction_yield_ng_ul.descr: Nucleic acid yield after extraction in ng/µL, if measured.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used; examples: Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, MiSeq, Oxford Nanopore.

library_preparation_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used prior to sequencing.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy; examples: shotgun metagenomic, amplicon, paired-end shotgun.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs (bp) for each read end or average read length.

paired_end.descr: Whether sequencing was performed as paired-end reads.

library_id.descr: Library identifier linking the sample to a sequencing library.

barcode_or_index_sequence.descr: Sample barcode or index used for demultiplexing.

technical_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for a technical replicate, if applicable.

biological_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for a biological replicate, if applicable.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Number of reads generated for the sample after sequencing or demultiplexing.

qc_passed.descr: Indicates whether the sample passed predefined quality-control criteria.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes on QC issues, contamination concerns, low biomass, or deviations from protocol.

target_taxonomic_domain.descr: Primary taxonomic focus of the metagenomic analysis; examples: bacteria, archaea, fungi, viruses, all domains.

analysis_pipeline.descr: Bioinformatic pipeline or workflow used for metagenomic processing.

analysis_version.descr: Version of the analysis pipeline or software stack.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic or functional assignment.

pollution_index.descr: Optional composite index summarizing pollution burden at the site/time, if computed.

metadata_version.descr: Version of the metadata schema used for this record.
